title: Correlation with a linear form
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $b_i\in\mathbb R$ for each $i\in[n]$. Then
\[
\E_x\!\left[f(x)\sum_{i\in[n]} b_i\sigma(x_i)\right]
=\sum_{i\in[n]}b_i\widehat f(\{i\}),
\]
where $\widehat f(\{i\})=\E_x[f(x)\sigma(x_i)]$.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ assigns a real coefficient to each coordinate in $[n]$
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a real-valued cube function, and let $(b_i)_{i<n}$ be real coefficients.
With uniform expectation $\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$ and singleton Fourier coefficients $\widehat f(\{i\})=\mathbb E[f(x)(-1)^{x_i}]$, one has
\[
\mathbb E\!\left[f(x)\sum_{i<n}b_i(-1)^{x_i}\right]
 =\sum_{i<n}b_i\widehat f(\{i\}).
\]
